body.name: \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{sink}}\)
body.construction: A finite string containing the activation-fiber truth table, one authorized retained trace, one rooted C-forest bitmask, the rational fixed nuisance table \(\eta\), one rational baseline \(p_0\in(0,1)^r\), and one rational \(\varepsilon>0\). It contains no second parameter table, no list of observed-cell equalities, and no comparison of two query values.
